assessment_import_file_label: Excel file from DOT or the template
assessment_import_file_hint: .xlsx only, up to {size}. Save an .xls file as “Excel Workbook (.xlsx)” first.
assessment_import_template_hint: The template has an example of each question type and instructions.
assessment_import_format_title: How the file is laid out
assessment_import_format_d1: D1: time limit in minutes (0: none)
assessment_import_format_rows: Rows 2 and below: one question each
assessment_import_format_b: B: type: 1 single choice, 2 multiple choice, 3 short text, 4 matching, 5 essay
assessment_import_format_c: C: correct answer: option numbers separated by “;” (types 1 and 2), the expected text (3), pairs “1-2;2-1” (4)
assessment_import_format_d: D: difficulty level, when levels are on
assessment_import_format_e: E onward: answer options in a row, with no gaps
assessment_import_format_bold: Only column C sets the correct answer: bold text changes nothing.
assessment_import_gone: The uploaded file is no longer available: it is kept for 24 hours. Upload it again.
assessment_import_committed: A quiz has already been created from this file.
assessment_import_issues_title: What we found in the file
assessment_import_errors_hint: The quiz can’t be created while the file has errors: fix them in Excel and upload the file again.
assessment_import_settings_hint: Taken from row 1 of the file; you can change them.
assessment_import_no_chapters: The course has no chapter a quiz can be added to. Add a chapter on the Content tab first.
assessment_import_field_mode: What to do with the questions
assessment_import_mode_replace_hint: The quiz’s current questions will be deleted.
assessment_import_mode_append_hint: The file’s questions go after the current ones.
assessment_import_apply_hint: Attempts, time limit, questions per attempt and passing score from this form.
assessment_import_draw_hint: 0, blank or {total}: every question in each attempt.
assessment_import_draw_levels_hint: Difficulty levels are on: questions are drawn by DOT quotas.
assessment_import_partial_hint: For multiple choice and matching questions: the share answered right.
assessment_import_concepts_hint: After the import, the AI tags the questions with course concepts. The suggestions appear on the Concepts tab for your approval.
assessment_import_concepts_queued: The AI is suggesting concepts: review them on the Concepts tab.
assessment_import_newlines_hint: In DOT, “{token}” in text is a line break. Turn this on when it is part of code, such as a Java string.
assessment_import_not_editable: Questions can be loaded only into a draft with no attempts. Create a new quiz from this file.
assessment_import_fix_hint: Fix the file and upload it again.
assessment_import_issue_file_too_large: the file is larger than {max_mb} MB. Shrink the images or split the quiz into several files.
assessment_import_issue_xls_not_supporte: the .xls format is not supported. Save the file as “Excel Workbook (.xlsx)”.
assessment_import_issue_file_unreadable: the Excel file could not be read. Save it again as .xlsx.
assessment_import_issue_too_many_questio: the table is too large: at most {max} questions.
assessment_import_issue_too_many_options: too many answer options: at most {max}.
assessment_import_issue_not_non_negative: a whole number of 0 or more is expected.
assessment_import_issue_leveling_cell: difficulty levels: enter 0 or 1, or leave the cell empty.
assessment_import_issue_limit_too_big: the question limit is larger than the number of questions in the file ({total}).
assessment_import_issue_no_questions: the file has no questions: they start on row 2.
assessment_import_issue_formula: Excel formulas are not supported in the template. Replace the formula with its value or an image.
assessment_import_issue_cell_error: the cell holds an Excel error ({value}).
assessment_import_issue_no_question: the question has no text or image.
assessment_import_issue_type_invalid: enter a question type from 1 to 5.
assessment_import_issue_level_invalid: enter a difficulty level: 1, 2, 3, 101, 102, 201 or 202 (levels are on in F1). Answer options start at {cell}.
assessment_import_issue_level_disabled: difficulty levels are off (F1), so this cell must be empty or 0. Answer options start at {cell}.
assessment_import_issue_empty_between: an empty option between filled ones: options go in a row, with no gaps.
assessment_import_issue_too_few_options: at least {min} answer options are needed.
assessment_import_issue_correct_format: enter the correct option numbers separated by “;”, for example 1;3.
assessment_import_issue_single_needs_one: a single choice question needs exactly one correct option.
assessment_import_issue_correct_repeated: a correct option number is given twice.
assessment_import_issue_correct_out_of_r: there is no option {item}: there are {total} options.
assessment_import_issue_no_text_answer: the correct text answer is missing.
assessment_import_issue_matching_counts_: enter the number of items on the left and on the right separated by “;”, for example 3;4.
{left} on the left and {right} on the right are given, but {total} cells are filled.
assessment_import_issue_matching_pair_fo: the pair “{pair}” is written wrong: use “left number-right number”, for example 1-2.
assessment_import_issue_matching_pair_re: left item {left} appears in two pairs.
assessment_import_issue_matching_pair_ou: the pair {left}-{right} names an item that row {row} does not have.
assessment_import_issue_matching_pairs_i: give every left item a pair: a right number or 0.
assessment_import_issue_image_format: the image format is not supported. Paste it as PNG or JPEG.
assessment_import_issue_image_broken: the image is damaged and cannot be read. Paste it again.
assessment_import_issue_image_too_large: the image is too large: up to 5 MB and 8192 pixels per side.
assessment_import_issue_option_image_twi: an option can have only one image.
assessment_import_issue_image_outside: the image is not in a question or option cell. Move it to column A or to an option cell.
assessment_import_issue_text_too_long: the text is longer than {max} characters.
assessment_import_issue_service_cell: the DOT service cell B1 is not used in Ashyq and was skipped.
assessment_import_issue_bold_mismatch: option {bold} is in bold, but C says {correct}. C is what counts.
assessment_import_issue_duplicate_questi: the question repeats the question on row {row}. A learner may get both in a draw.
assessment_import_issue_suspicious_escap: the text contains “{token}”: it will be shown as is.
assessment_import_issue_shown_differentl: Excel shows the cell differently from how the quiz will: “{value}”.
assessment_import_issue_merged_cells: merged cells {range}: only the top-left one holds the value.
assessment_import_issue_hidden_row: row {row} is hidden but is imported.
assessment_import_issue_hidden_column: column {column} is hidden but is imported.
assessment_import_issue_attempts_capped: Ashyq allows at most {max} attempts; set to {max}.

match.nPlural=one: {n} type 5 question will need a manual review.
match.nPlural=other: {n} type 5 questions will need a manual review.

assessment_import_issue_matching_image_d: images in matching items are not supported and were skipped.
assessment_import_issue_unescaped_newlin: “{token}” was turned into a line break in cells: {cells}.
assessment_import_issue_trimmed: spaces at the edges were removed in cells ({count}): {cells}.
assessment_import_issue_shapes_skipped: shapes without an image were skipped: {cells}.
assessment_import_issue_other_sheets: sheet “{sheet}” was read; sheets {names} were skipped.
